text:
infra-bot: Release train update — quiet window (APAC) remains in effect. We're running a short readout thread; see notes below and the actions list. :clipboard:

maya: Quick summary: overnight node reprovisioning in ap-northeast-1 hit a quota bump + unexpected preemptions. Autoscaler response created transient spikes in scheduling latency. No data plane degradation for Dedicated customers observed.

ryan: Heads-up for comms folks: prepping a status page entry for impacted hosted endpoints in APAC. Draft will be in #customer-success in 10m. Dedicated tenants: include explicit "no impact to reserved pools" line.

theo: Rollout policy reminder: we won't proceed with non-urgent merges to main for APAC services until the readout clears. Rollback / abort thresholds: error rate >5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >2x baseline triggers auto-hold. Commands: `rw release abort --reason "thresholds-exceeded"` or `kubectl scale deployment --replicas=0 -n infra <svc>` for emergency stop.

kate: Can we safely shorten the freeze if reprovision finishes ahead of schedule? Process: post a status update here, @oncall + infra lead must ack, then ops-bot will lift the freeze. No unilateral lift.

maya: Mitigations applied: slowed down node reprovision concurrency, bumped scheduling backoff to 15s, and enabled temporary cross-region read routing for low-priority routes. Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rollouts/apac-capacity (sensitive).

ryan: Exec comms: @ceo asked for a one-paragraph readout for the 23:30 UTC briefing. I'll draft and drop it here for review in 20m.

theo: Ops checklist I'm tracking (will update):
```
- verify quota adjustments
n- confirm no dedicated pool evictions
- validate auto-fallback routing working
- run smoke set on core endpoints (10 reqs/min)
- hold non-critical canaries
```

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor the canaries and approve any `urgent-hotfix` labels. Ping me with PR links.

kate: Also adding a short note to the Console deploy UX about the temporary rule: attempting to override freeze requires `--approvers oncall,infra-lead`. Helps reduce accidental bypasses.

maya: Postmortem stub I'll start: root_cause, timeline, mitigation, follow-ups (autoscaler tuning, quota alerting). Will share a draft by EOD.

ryan: :+1: I'll coordinate customer-friendly wording. If anyone has a customer impact snippet, drop it here.

infra-bot: Next update in 30m or on status change.
